scope: Isolated Mac Test runtime tasks; provider transport intervals, not UI or TTFT
selection: Model requests within the main conversation Run interval; separate cancellation probe excluded. Failed unsealed Run bounded by the next probe Run start.
cache_denominator: Sum of observed input_tokens; numerator sum of input_tokens_details.cached_tokens. All selected requests have usage.
caveats: Different tasks and builds; not an A/B experiment or percentile baseline
Provider durations include transport and output generation, not just inference
Run elapsed minus provider durations is not pure tool execution time
Reasoning capability false omits reasoning control; it does not prove server reasoning is disabled
Build time and separate cancellation probe are excluded
